title: SpaceX's Starship just did its first "soft landing" without exploding
caption:
SpaceX's Starship just did a "soft landing" in the Indian Ocean on Flight 13, the first time it came down without exploding into pieces.

You're watching the world's tallest rocket come back to Earth from a view most people will never see. Every landing like this gets SpaceX closer to sending people to Mars for real.
